That accounts for all 24 drums. Before I can finalize the disposition on the waste-closeout form, I need to flag two documentation gaps that need to be corrected. Jon, the lab classification report needs to be uploaded to the waste log so the record is complete. Priya, the hold tags for the 6 VX-204 drums need to be entered in the production system. Additionally, the waste-closeout form will require separate commitments for each disposition category — recovery, incineration, and on-site retention — and a treatment manifest for the total number of drums removed from the cage. Since the 6 retained drums are not being removed for treatment, we'll need to be clear about how the manifest accounts for the 18 drums being sent out versus the 6 being retained. Can both of you confirm you'll get those documentation gaps corrected before Friday, and can we agree on these disposition numbers so I can prepare the closeout form?
